_doc: Role C (solver) physical parameters for the ruler-buckling rod model. SI units. provenance: assumed | declared | geometry (scene_params geometry x assumed density) | measured | fitted. Nothing here is fitted to the AI reference.

nu.provenance: assumed (not used: planar Kirchhoff rod, plate effect b/t=50 -> see notes)

free_length_m.provenance: declared: jaw top z=0.095 to strip top z=0.375

tip_body._doc: rigid body bolted to the strip top; offsets measured along the strip tangent from the top of the flexible part (= 12 mm below the strip top, where the platform tabs end). Dead load at the body's CoM.

rigid_top_strip_m.provenance: geometry: platform tabs (12 mm tall, both faces, 2 screws) clamp the top 12 mm of the strip -> flexible length 0.268 m

pieces.name: screws_x2
pieces.provenance: geometry est. (heads x1.6 for shanks) x 7900, as physics/derive.py

pieces.name: peg_steel
pieces.provenance: geometry v002 (d4 x 40 mm, lead) x 7900

tip_body.platform_total_kg_note: 13.94 g from geometry (matches physics/benchmarks.json v002 m0, 40 mm peg)

first_weight_base_offset_m.provenance: geometry: 12 mm rigid strip + 3 mm plate; weights stack on the plate top

loading.schedule_source: lead decision (message superseding CHANGELOG 09:22Z): 7 weights seated at 1.0,1.6,2.2,2.8,3.4,4.0,4.6 s; t_j = start of the contact-force ramp; mass/inertia joins the tip body at release t_j + tau. measurement/summary.json key weight_arrival_times_s would override.

ramp_s.provenance: assumed per physics/FORMULATION.md: contact force m_w g S((t-t0)/tau), S = smootherstep; mass+inertia added as a step at release t0+tau

tip_offset_m.provenance: assumed: stress-free initial bow y0 = d0 (1-cos(pi s/2Lf)), |d0| = Lf/~1000 = 0.28 mm, towards -Y (camera side; leans screen-left, away from the weight stack)

alpha_M_per_s.provenance: assumed per FORMULATION: Rayleigh mass-proportional, zeta=0.005 at 1 Hz (Q1~50 overall, clamp/joint friction dominated)

eta_s.provenance: assumed per FORMULATION: Rayleigh stiffness-proportional on bending stiffness, zeta=0.02 at 20 Hz

Cd_plate.provenance: assumed (flat plate normal flow; quadratic drag on strip lateral velocity)
